title: How to Make Viral Animated Shorts Using Claude (Full Workflow)
description:
How to make viral animated shorts with Claude, step by step. I gave Claude a channel's latest 20 shorts, it studied them frame by frame at 30 fps, and then it built a full animated short with our own story: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, made with three.js on my own PC. No AI video generator.

In this video:
• Claude watches 20 shorts at 30 fps and writes a style bible
• The script formula it found, and why the hook is one sentence
• Picking our own story: the bridge that fell for a song
• Building the town, the characters and the camera in three.js
• Why the first version looked cheap
• Seven agents comparing our frames with the reference, one topic each
• What they found: ink lines, lens blur, camera glides and shadow colours
• The free skill, so you can make the same type of short
